versions.content: Handling if attempts to update an PHY with a MAC security entity configuration and the establishment of an transmit secure channel has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateSecY was called for an EthTrcvConfig with EthTr- cvMacSecEnabled set to TRUE and the update process for the corresponding PHY with the MAC security entity configuration and the establishment of an transmission secured channel has been successfully finalized, then the EthTrcv driver shall no- tify the EthIf by calling EthIf_MacSecUpdateSecYNotification with CtrlIdx set to the corresponding EthIfController and with Result set to E_OK . Other- wise the EthTrcv driver shall call EthIf_MacSecUpdateSecYNotification with Result set to E_NOT_OK .
